settings.name_in_paper: stochastic low-rank bandit (simplified problem: learning (I*, J*))
unmapped: Mean reward matrix R = U V^T of rank d with K rows and L columns, U in S_{K,d}, V in S_{L,d} (rows in the simplex)
Hott topics assumption: all rows of U (resp. V) are convex combinations of d base rows and the zero vector
Action is a pair (d-subset of rows, d-subset of columns); learner observes noisy realizations of all d x d entries; reward is the entry at the best pair within the chosen submatrix
Noise on entries is independent across observed entries
Learner knows the number of columns L
The analysed algorithm observes many d-rows/d-columns per step (all remaining rows and columns during exploration)
settings.definition_quote: An instance of this problem is defined by a tuple $(U, V, P)$, where $U \in \mathcal{S}_{K, d}$ are latent row factors, $V \in \mathcal{S}_{L, d}$ are latent column factors ... At time $t$, the agent chooses arm $(\rnd{I}_t, \rnd{J}_t) \in \Pi_d([K]) \times \Pi_d([L])$, a pair of $d$-subsets of rows and columns, and observes a noisy realization of matrix $\bar{R}(\rnd{I}_t, \rnd{J}_t)$ ... The reward is $\rnd{r}_t(i^\ast(\rnd{I}_t, \rnd{J}_t), j^\ast(\rnd{I}_t, \rnd{J}_t))$

bound.expression_latex: \frac{c d^3 (K + L)}{c_{\max} c_{\min}^2 \Delta_{\min}} C(n) + 4,\ c = 3072,\ C(n) = 4 \det_{\max}^2(d) \log((K^d + L^d) n)

symbols.L_col: number of columns of the matrix (paper's L)
symbols.c_min: minimum volume: min over d-rows/d-columns of det^2(U(I,:)), det^2(V(J,:))
symbols.Delta_vol: minimum gap over suboptimal d-rows and d-columns, Delta_I = det^2(U(I*,:)) - det^2(U(I,:)) (paper's Delta_min)
symbols.det_max: maximum determinant of a d x d matrix with entries in [0,1]

conditions: hott topics assumption on U and V
c_min > 0 (any d rows and columns of R are linearly independent)
independent noise on matrix entries, rewards in [0,1]
tuning: n_l = ceil(4 Delta_tilde_l^{-2} C(n)), stages halving Delta_tilde

source.label: thm:upper bound
source.quote: The expected $n$-step regret of $\lowrankelim$ is bounded as \mathcal{R}(n) \leq \frac{c d^3 (K + L)}{c_{\max} c_{\min}^2 \Delta_{\min}} C(n) + 4, where $c = 3072$, $c_{\max}$ is defined in \eqref{eq:maximum volume}, $c_{\min}$ is defined in \eqref{eq:minimum volume}, $\Delta_{\min}$ is defined in \eqref{eq:minimum gap}, and $C(n)$ is defined in \eqref{eq:log n}.

results.notes: Regret defined via stochastic rewards of the same round of optimal vs chosen entry; in expectation equals mean differences, so pseudo-regret. Delta_min is a volume gap (not a reward gap), so declared as Delta_vol; the paper's definition has a typo (Delta^u used for columns). Computation is exponential in d. The discussion gives an informal improved bound replacing c_min by an averaged volume c_bar for a modified algorithm (not a formal statement, not recorded).
